subject.title: Compaction should use auth-profile rotation / failover within the same provider

question: Should compaction adopt same-provider auth-profile failover for auto-selected profiles while keeping user-selected profiles locked and applying at most one result to a stable transcript snapshot?
rationale: The behavior matches existing normal-run profile rotation, but compaction retries affect auth routing and session-state correctness, so maintainers need to approve the permanent retry boundary before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Land bounded same-provider failover
options.body: Review and land or replace the linked PR with same-provider-only rotation, user-lock preservation, and stable-snapshot apply-once protection.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify a smaller compaction failover contract or extra proof requirements for the linked PR.

options.title: Decline compaction rotation
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue only if maintainers intentionally want compaction to remain stricter than normal agent turns.

recommendation.title: Land bounded same-provider failover
recommendation.body: Review and land or replace the linked PR with same-provider-only rotation, user-lock preservation, and stable-snapshot apply-once protection.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on auth-profile design and model-failover behavior that this compaction policy would extend.
